subject: Subprocessor scope change: request for approval and DPA evidence
messages:
From: Anya Petrov <anya@acmecloud.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: legal-team@acmecloud.com
Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2024 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: LogStream will process logs for Acme — subprocessor add

Hi Sofia,

Per our contract (Section 3.2), we are adding LogStream, Inc. as a subprocessor for ingestion and retention of telemetry related to Redwood integrations. Attached is the official subprocessor notice and a short summary from LogStream.

Key items:
- Purpose: log collection and short-term retention for diagnostics (90 days).
- Data types: service logs, anonymized request IDs, no user PII expected.
- Location: US-based processing.

Can you confirm whether Redwood needs a DPA amendment or an Order Form addendum to proceed? If you need additional evidence (SOC2, encryption attestations), LogStream can provide an evidence packet — I've cc’d their ops contact.

Attachments: Acme_LogStream_Subprocessor_Notice_2024-04-23.pdf

Thanks,
Anya Petrov
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Cloud

--
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrov <anya@acmecloud.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Apr 2024 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: LogStream will process logs for Acme — subprocessor add

Hi Anya — thanks for the heads up and for looping in LogStream ops.

Quick internal note (cc’ing our procurement and legal): we’ll need: 
1) Scope confirmation (are any customer identifiers or content included?),
2) LogStream’s most recent SOC 2 Type II or equivalent,
3) DPA excerpt for subprocessor obligations (encryption, access controls, retention), and
4) A proposed redline if they request to be added to our MSA/Order Form.

Karthik — can you triage the evidence packet when it arrives and propose whether an Order Form addendum suffices vs. an MSA amendment? Laura / Naomi — please advise on risk tolerance for 90-day retention and whether we need to require anonymization controls in the DPA.

I’ll hold on formal approval until we have their SOC2 and the DPA excerpts.

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

--
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Anya Petrov <anya@acmecloud.com>, eng-ops@logstream.io
Date: Fri, 26 Apr 2024 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: LogStream will process logs for Acme — subprocessor add

Thanks — I spoke to LogStream ops yesterday. They sent an evidence bundle (SOC2 summary + DPA excerpt + ingest architecture). Attaching the files to this thread. Notes from the call:
- They confirm no user content or PII is intentionally forwarded; only service-level logs and request IDs.
- Data is pseudonymized at ingestion; full identifiers are not stored longer than 24 hours. Retention policy for debug artifacts is 90 days.
- Access: role-based with MFA; they use AES-256 at rest and TLS in transit.

Risks flagged:
- 90-day retention may be longer than some of our customers require; recommend we require retention-justification in the DPA and an option to shorten per-customer settings.
- Need explicit subcontractor flow-down requiring the same access-controls and encryption clauses as in our MSA.

Recommendation: request a small DPA addendum (attachment: LogStream_DPA_Summary.xlsx) and a redline to our MSA highlighting the flowdown clause. If Acme wants a blanket Order Form update, capture the subprocessor in an Order Form Annex; otherwise DPA addendum is quicker.

Attachments: redline_MSA_Acme_v2.docx; LogStream_DPA_Summary.xlsx

-Karthik
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference

--
From: legal-team@acmecloud.com <legal-team@acmecloud.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Apr 2024 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Notice: LogStream will process logs for Acme — subprocessor add

On Mon, Apr 29, 2024 at 09:00 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi team — attached is our proposed redline to limit retention to 60 days for Acme’s production tenants and require per-customer retention overrides. Also tightened flowdown language for subcontractors. See comments inline.

Thanks, Laura — the 60-day cap is acceptable to Acme for production logging; we’ll need to preserve 90 days for a small set of pre-prod/test tenants during an agreed ramp, but we can capture that in an Order Form annex.

We’ve reviewed the flowdown language and attached a clean DPA addendum with LogStream signatures pending. Please confirm whether Redwood needs LogStream to sign Redwood’s standard Data Processing Addendum or if the DPA addendum with explicit flowdown obligations is sufficient.

Best,
Anya Petrov
On behalf of Acme Legal

Attachment referenced: Acme_response_clean_DPA_addendum.pdf

--
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrov <anya@acmecloud.com>, legal-team@acmecloud.com
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 May 2024 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: LogStream will process logs for Acme — subprocessor add

Anya — thank you for the quick review and the DPA addendum.

Summary / next steps:
- Redwood accepts a 60-day production retention default for Acme; we will capture the 90-day pre-prod exemption in an Order Form annex.
- LogStream must execute Redwood’s DPA addendum (we’ve attached a signature block).
- We require LogStream to sign the subcontractor flowdown (clause 4.3 in our redline_MSA_Acme_v2.docx) or provide a written equivalent that binds their downstream processors.
- Karthik: please prepare the final Order Form annex and DPA package; loop in procurement for DocuSign routing.
- Sofia / Markus: can you confirm whether we should add a short comment to the customer-facing security page about subprocessor additions?

Attachments: redline_MSA_Acme_v2.docx (with inline comments), final_DPA_addendum_for_signature.pdf

Thanks all — aiming to close the paperwork by EOD 05/06 to not delay the onboarding window.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
